prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 15.1% lower than a year ago. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, growth, what the price implies.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 6 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 62 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth.
